default.text: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs: Elo projects DEN by 3.2, with Ridge close behind at DEN by 3.4, while LightGBM sees a much tighter game at DEN by 0.9. The market disagrees with the stronger model readings, pricing KC as a 2.5-point favorite. That gap - about 5.7 points - is real, but the system's spread and moneyline calls are both no bet right now, pending complete market and research data. Research flagged a significant, unresolved risk: Kansas City's starting quarterback is working back from a major injury with no live game reps this preseason, which is exactly the kind of uncertainty a frozen statistical model can't see on its own.
